messages.author: 0533e5c119864fb7
messages.subject: Error message using animal.inla
parts:
Hi everyone,

I just started to use the INLA and Animal.INLA package through R. In trying to run the example (Gaussian, Sparrow data) provided in the manual (November, 2013), I got the following error message:

Error in inla(formula, family = type.data, data = data, verbose = verbose,  : 
  unused argument (control.data = list(hyper = list(theta = prec.fixed.generic2))).


I'd appreciate any information or comment.

Regards,

Napo V.

parts:
replace 'control.data' with 'control.family', a name-change made long
time ago.

H

messages.author: 8dbb28b015bb7762
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Error message using animal.inla
parts:
You have to do those changes *within* the AnimalINLA package.
This means that you need to download the source, make the changes, and reinstall the package with your modifications.

I have done it. So you might want to benefit from that.
In fact, there were some other changes in the INLA syntaxis that were not translated to the AnimalINLA package.
Namely, inla.marginal.transform and inla.expectation are called now inla.tmarginal and inla.emarginal respectively.
I have changed those as well in my fixes.

You can proceed as follows:
install.packages('devtools')
library(devtools)
install_github('myAnimalINLAfixes', 'famuvie')

Now you have my little package with the modified version of the function animal.inla()
To use it, you simply load my package *after* AnimalINLA, which will override the original function.
library(AnimalINLA)
library(myAnimalINLAfixes)

Then you can use it.

Hope it helps.
        ƒacu.-
